comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This album is related to items randomly dropped by the boss group found in the [ZONE:90006620] endless dungeon (accessible only from the Acropolis of Atlantis port when Atlantis is available in the server). Items are:

Godly Bracelet
Kairos' Talisman
Bowl of Hygieia

Reward: Staff of Light
Obtained from El Greco (Seville)

Further info on Atlantis and its treasures can be found here: uwo-atlantis.blogspot.com/2019/07/atlantis.html

Cheers.

wiki:
How to complete: defeat the "???" / Temple Guardian bosses in the Temple of Poseidon Endless Dungeon (only accessible from Acropolis of Atlantis if Atlantis is present on Maris server). Each item is randomly dropped after victory in battle. IMPORTANT: you must have open slots in your inventory to receive the item drop for MA!

Godly Bracelet (hidden passage black aura & b50+ red aura; low drop rate)
Kairos' Talisman (same as above, but slightly higher drop rate and confirmed from B30+ bosses)
Bowl of Hygieia (dropped by all bosses, common drop rate)

Reward: Staff of Light
NPC: El Greco (Seville)
